description: This file defines the Review controller class for the Goteo PHP application. It handles user review-related functionalities such as viewing assigned reviews, managing review activities, evaluating, and viewing history. The class contains multiple action methods corresponding to different review sections, leveraging models for data retrieval and views for rendering.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: Controller class managing review-related actions such as displaying assigned reviews, managing review activities, evaluating reviews, and viewing review history.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the review index page with assigned reviews, or a message if none are assigned.

methods.name: activity
methods.description: Shows the current user's activity, including assigned reviews and options related to their review tasks.

methods.name: reviews
methods.description: Handles actions related to specific reviews, such as marking a review as complete, selecting a review, or opening a review by ID, as well as evaluating and commenting on reviews.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Displays the review history for the user, with options to view details of previous reviews.

methods.name: menu
methods.description: Provides a menu structure for navigating review sections.
